rows.it: Il segnale raffigurato vieta il transito a tutti gli autoveicoli

en.current: The sign shown prohibits the passage of all motor vehicles
en.proposed: The sign shown prohibits the passage of all motor vehicles with at least four wheels, excluding motorcycle-class vehicles, including motor tricycles and motor quadricycles

zh-Hans.current: 图中所示标志禁止所有机动车通行
zh-Hans.proposed: 图中所示标志禁止所有至少有四个车轮的机动车通行，但不包括归为摩托车类的车辆，例如机动四轮车

es-419.current: La señal mostrada prohíbe el paso a todos los vehículos de motor
es-419.proposed: La señal mostrada prohíbe el paso a todos los vehículos de motor de al menos cuatro ruedas, excepto los vehículos de la categoría de motocicletas, incluidos los triciclos y cuadriciclos de motor

evidence.support: Art. 54(1) defines autoveicoli as motor vehicles of at least four wheels, excluding motoveicoli; its classes include cars, buses and trucks.
Art. 53 classifies motoveicoli separately, including two-wheeled motorcycles, three-wheeled motoveicoli and motor quadricycles.
Art. 52 defines ciclomotori as motor vehicles; hence a general term for all motor vehicles also includes vehicles outside autoveicoli.
DPR 495/1992 art. 117(1)(g): sign II.58 prohibits all autoveicoli, including three-wheeled motoveicoli and motor quadricycles.

rows.reason: The current broad term includes categories outside autoveicoli. The draft expresses Article 54(1) as motor vehicles with at least four wheels excluding the motoveicoli category, with motor quadricycles as an example of that exclusion. It preserves the universal quantifier and the asserted prohibition or end of prohibition.
rows.ambiguity: The legal category motoveicoli has no exact cross-language equivalent; motorcycle-class and its target-language equivalents are approximate labels, clarified by examples. Article 117(1)(g) separately extends sign II.58 to three-wheeled motoveicoli and motor quadricycles; that sign scope does not redefine autoveicoli in the statement.
